flaws.note: The request origin is echoed into Access-Control-Allow-Origin together with Allow-Credentials: true, so any site can read the signed-in user's documents through the public API.
name is joined under the workspace folder without normalisation; ../ reaches other workspaces' files and anything else on disk.
The real .env is committed (.gitignore does not list it) and SESSION_SECRET is still the placeholder from .env.example, so session cookies can be forged.
